name: RevealCard
description: Card whose accent-colored overlay springs in from any edge on hover or keyboard focus to reveal the title, body copy and optional actions.
a11yNotes: Root is a focusable <article> labelled by the title; the overlay opens on hover and on focus-within, so tabbing to the card or to a link inside reveals it. The decorative cover is aria-hidden while the overlay text stays in the accessibility tree, and prefers-reduced-motion replaces the slide with a short fade.

defaultProps.title: Reveal Card
defaultProps.body: A spring-driven overlay slides in on hover or keyboard focus, carrying the detail without leaving the card.
